effect.en:
Roll a dice for each **Blue Horror** model in this unit that is slain. For each 3+, if there are fewer **Brimstone Horrors** models in this unit than its starting size, you can add 1 **Brimstone Horrors** model to this unit. 

**Designer’s Note:** *Dice are only rolled for Blue Horror models that are currently slain – models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count until they are slain once more. When adding Brimstone Horrors to this unit, do not count slain Brimstone Horrors towards the maximum.*

Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.

wargear.en:
***This unit starts the battle with 10 Blue Horror models or, if it is a reinforced unit, 20 Blue Horror models.***

***Brimstone Horrors models can be added to this unit using the ‘Split Again’ ability.***

melee.ja: Flaming Maws and Blue Horrors’ Jabs

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.

melee.ja: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.
Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn, Any Shooting Phase

effect.en: Roll a D3. Allocate a number of damage points to this unit equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

wargear.en:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Warping Wyrdfire and Daemonic Talons. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Ephilim the Unknowable** (champion)*
• ***Spawnmaw***
• ***Flamespooler***
• ***Kindlefinger***
• ***Apo’trax, the Starefysh***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. Add the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to the roll. On a 5+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick up to 2 visible friendly **FLAMERS OF TZEENTCH** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

effect.en: Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

name.ja: Fateskimmer, Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot

melee.ja: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

effect.en: Companion weapons used by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 **fate point**.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

effect.en: The target has the **BURNING** keyword for the rest of the battle.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed or is in reserve. Pick any number of **BURNING** enemy units to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 1, the target no longer has the **BURNING** keyword. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

name.ja: Fluxmaster, Herald of Tzeentch on Disc

melee.ja: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit

effect.en: Re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• The effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to the target.
Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

effect.en: You control the target objective.

name.ja: Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch

declare.en: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

effect.en: You control the target objective.
Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.

If this unit has not already **engineered the outcome** this battle round, instead of making a casting roll, unbinding roll, banishment roll, hit roll, wound roll or save roll for a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, this unit can **engineer the outcome**.

If the roll would have been a D6 roll, you can use a value of 6 for it that cannot be modified. If the roll would have been a 2D6 roll, you can use a value of 9 for it that cannot be modified.
When you make a casting roll for this unit, you can change the lowest D6 to match the highest D6.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target charged in the same turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units in combat with the target have Strike‑first.
• The target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **CHARGE (+1 DAMAGE)** weapon ability.

Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, if a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit unbinds a spell, no command points are spent for that **WIZARD** to use the ‘Magical Intervention’ command in that phase.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly non‑**HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

effect.en: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

declare.en: Pick another visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase, but it must end that move closer to this unit.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.
Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Split:*** Pick a visible friendly **Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit.

***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

name.ja: Scourge of Aqshy: Screamers of Tzeentch

effect.en: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

effect.en: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

units.notes_en: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.

effect.en:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit.
This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

The next time this unit uses a non‑**SUMMON SPELL** ability this phase, do not make a casting roll as part of that ability. Instead, roll a dice. On a 2+, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound.

declare.en: Pick a friendly unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Until the start of your next turn:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make an unmodified ward roll of 1-3 for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to the target.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units can use the ‘Redeploy’ command even if they were set up in the same turn.

declare.en: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick a model in a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.

effect.en: This unit can immediately use a **SPELL** ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities such as ‘Unbind’.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.
